## Model-call audit against the 5.5 API changes (2026-11-09 PST)

Scope: every model call path in `src/rebar` — the pydantic-ai runner (`llm/runner.py`, `llm/structured_run.py`, `llm/agent_call.py`), provider construction (`llm/anthropic_model.py`, `llm/bedrock_model.py`, `llm/providers.py`), and the two raw-SDK sites (`anthropic_model._move_unsupported_beta_create_kwargs`, `evals/provider_parity.probe_slot`). Every gate pass, the completion verifier, code review, scan-spec and the workflow steps reach the model only through `PydanticAIRunner.run`, so the runner rows cover them.

### Wire probe (riskiest assumption)

One short call per case, each 5.5 model, each provider (Bedrock `us.anthropic.*-5-5` via boto3 `converse`; direct `claude-*-5-5` via the Anthropic SDK):

| model | bare | `temperature=0` | explicit `effort` |
|---|---|---|---|
| Opus 5.5 (Bedrock, direct) | accepted, `end_turn` | 400 "`temperature` is deprecated for this model." | accepted (`high`) |
| Sonnet 5.5 (Bedrock, direct) | accepted, `end_turn` | 400, same message | accepted (`high`) |
| Haiku 5.5 (Bedrock, direct) | accepted, `end_turn` | 400, same message | accepted (`medium`) |

### Findings

| # | API change | site | finding | disposition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | forced `tool_choice` `any`/`tool` 400s (Opus, Sonnet) | `structured.output_mode` (`llm/structured.py:149`), `runner.py:273` | rebar never forces a tool. Structured output is `NativeOutput` or `PromptedOutput` only; no `ToolOutput` exists in the stack; agentic loops use pydantic-ai's default `auto`. `git grep tool_choice -- src` finds only comments. | not affected |
| 2 | thinking cannot be disabled (Opus 5.5) | `RunRequest.thinking` (`runner.py:93`) | no caller sets thinking, and no `anthropic_thinking`/`thinking` setting is sent anywhere, so rebar never sends `{type: "disabled"}` or a budget. Opus 5.5 therefore runs adaptive thinking by default. Claude output stays `PromptedOutput` (`capabilities._REBAR_OVERRIDES`), which is compatible with thinking. | not affected |
| 3 | `temperature`/`top_p`/`top_k` rejected | `structured_run.build_model_settings` (`:400-404`); Pass-2 verify and `completion.py:397` set `temperature=0`; `evals/plan_replay/tier1.py:110`, `tier2.py:391,580` | **affected**: the 4.x verifier path sends `temperature=0`, which 400s on every 5.5 model (probe above). `top_p`/`top_k` are never sent. | **fixed**: every 5.5 id (bare, `us.`, `global.`) gets `supports_temperature: False` in `_MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES`, so the builder withdraws it on both providers (pinned by `test_five_five_ids_withdraw_temperature_and_pin_effort` and `test_the_temperature_withdrawal_is_symmetric_across_provider_arms`). |
| 4 | assistant prefill rejected | runner, structured stack | no call ends `messages` on an assistant turn: rebar passes no `message_history`, and the prompted path's single bounded retry appends the validation error as a user turn. | not affected |
| 5 | Opus 5.5 / Haiku 5.5 default `effort` to `medium` | `build_model_settings` | **affected**: rebar sent no effort, so 4.x ran at the API default `high`; on 5.5 the same request would silently run Opus at `medium`. | **fixed**: a per-model `effort` on `ModelCapabilities` (`high` Opus/Sonnet 5.5, `medium` Haiku 5.5), emitted as `anthropic_effort` and as Bedrock `additionalModelRequestFields.output_config.effort`. `test_the_pinned_effort_reaches_the_wire_on_both_provider_arms` captures both providers' payloads and asserts `output_config.effort == "high"`. |
| 6 | `refusal` stop reason (new on Haiku; Opus/Sonnet classifiers broadened) | `failure.py:263,369-375` | pydantic-ai maps Anthropic `refusal` and Bedrock `content_filtered`/`guardrail_intervened` to `finish_reason=content_filter`; rebar classifies that as a complete-but-unusable turn (`errors.py:203`), never a PASS. Bedrock Converse's `StopReason` enum (botocore 1.43.75) has no `refusal` member, so a Bedrock refusal arrives as `content_filtered` and takes the same path. | not affected |
| 7 | output ceiling / window | `review_kernel/verify.py::MODEL_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS`, `model_classes.MODEL_WINDOW_LADDER` | 5.5 rows added (128K output, 1M window for all three). The ladder's 4.x rows were removed; the conservative window for an unlocated model is kept at 200K as `UNLOCATED_MODEL_WINDOW_TOKENS` rather than derived from the (now all-1M) ladder minimum. | fixed |
| 8 | prompt-cache minimum | `capabilities._MODEL_CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS` | 5.5 models cache from 512 tokens (Opus 4.8: 1024; Haiku 4.5: 4096). | fixed: three rows at 512 |
| 9 | raw SDK sites | `anthropic_model._move_unsupported_beta_create_kwargs`; `provider_parity.probe_slot` | the first only relocates sampling kwargs the runner already withdraws; the second is the operator probe and intentionally sends `temperature=0` to measure the rejection. | not affected |
| 10 | pydantic-ai 1.107.9 profile | `pydantic_ai/profiles/anthropic.py::anthropic_model_profile` | does not list 5.5 ids, so its profile claims forced tool choice supported and sampling allowed. Neither is reachable (rows 1 and 3), and `anthropic_effort` is copied to `output_config.effort` unconditionally (`models/anthropic.py:1960-1978`), so no profile override is needed. 1.107.10 is a security-only release. | not affected |

No incompatibility needed a change outside this ticket's seams, so no bug was filed from the audit.

## Audit addendum, row 11 (2026-11-09, ~16:40 PST): reasoning-in-output declined on Bedrock Opus 5.5

This supersedes the earlier audit's closing line ("No incompatibility needed a change outside this ticket's seams"). The first "after" prompt-eval run turned up one incompatibility the code reading missed.

**Observation.** On commit 5c89609a0aa, every `code-review-failover` case scored coverage 0.00 with `run error: the response was blocked (finish_reason=content_filter)`. The same case passed on 4.x.

**Investigation (one change per test).**
- Bedrock Opus 5.5 declined it on every request; direct Anthropic Opus 5.5 completed it (coverage 1.0, PASS); Bedrock Opus 4.8 completed it.
- Removing the new effort pin: still declined. Effort ruled out.
- The bare diff with a one-line instruction: accepted on all three. The trigger is in rebar's request.
- Captured request, raw replay: declined. Without tools: declined. Without the system prompt: declined.
- Only the `analysis` field description "Scratchpad — reason before emitting." removed or made neutral: accepted.
- The verifier's "REASON FIRST: brief reasoning … before the answers": declined 2 of 2 on Bedrock Opus 5.5, accepted 2 of 2 on Bedrock Sonnet 5.5.
- The same field is in plan review's Pass-1 contract (`plan_review/passes.py:72`). One `plan-review-T10` case on Bedrock Opus 5.5: 3 of 3 requests declined, coverage 0.00. As committed, the upgrade would have made gated plan reviews INDETERMINATE on the production provider.

The pattern matches Anthropic's documented `reasoning_extraction` safeguard (a request asking the model to reproduce its reasoning in the response). Bedrock's `content_filtered` carries no category, so the category is inferred, not observed.

**Fix (in this change).** Four descriptions reworded as neutral notes: `code_review/contracts.py:75,93`, `plan_review/passes.py:72`, `review_kernel/verify_models.py:126`. The field and its shape are unchanged, so no payload or fixture changes. After the fix, on Bedrock Opus 5.5: `code-review-failover` coverage 1.0, PASS; `plan-review-T10` coverage 1.0, PASS. `tests/unit/test_output_contract_no_reasoning_in_output.py` scans every registered contract and fails on the pre-fix `passes.py` (checked).

Commit amended to 6f54ea438de (same Change-Id). The ticket description and file impact are updated to match, so the plan is being re-reviewed.

Reading: no spec regressed from PASS to FAIL; code-review-api-compat and spec-alignment moved FAIL to PASS. Every spec failing on 5.5 fails identically on 4.x: three have no solver (bug knightly-salty-orangutan, coverage 0.00 on both), seven plan-review specs fail schema validation on a 'dimension' field on both, and the rest are false-fire/miss gates on both. Parity: both 5.5 slots are invalid=false with zero sampling_parameter/auth_validation errors (the 4.x standard slot had 13+17 step-budget/runaway errors; 5.5 has none). The 5.5 standard slot has 1 gold-regressing flip (ELE-F1, block on direct, advisory on Bedrock; one gold-improving flip NETMECH-F1 the other way), so it does not meet the 0-flip parity bar; the 4.x frontier slot failed the same bar with 1 flip plus a false-accept rise. ## Context / Problem

The project pins Opus 4.8, Sonnet 4.6 and Haiku 4.5 (`rebar.toml`, `.github/llm-providers/*.toml`). Bedrock (896586841071/us-east-1) serves the 5.5 inference profiles. The epic lands this first, on the current engine.

A bare swap is unsafe: on 5.5 forced `tool_choice` and assistant prefill 400, Opus thinking cannot be disabled, sampling parameters 400, and Opus/Haiku default `effort` to `medium`. pydantic-ai-slim 1.107.9's profile does not list 5.5 ids.

## Approach

**Riskiest assumption first (measured).** rebar sends no forced tool choice, thinking toggle or prefill: `structured.output_mode` (`src/rebar/llm/structured.py:149`) returns only `NativeOutput` or `PromptedOutput`; `capabilities._REBAR_OVERRIDES` (`capabilities.py:214`) pins Claude to `PromptedOutput`; no caller sets `RunRequest.thinking=True` (`runner.py:93`). The wire behaviour was probed on 2026-11-09 with one short call per case on each 5.5 model, on Bedrock (boto3 `converse`) and direct Anthropic (SDK): a bare call is accepted, `temperature=0` is rejected (400 "`temperature` is deprecated for this model"), and `effort` (Bedrock `additionalModelRequestFields={"output_config": {"effort": ...}}`, direct `output_config.effort`) is accepted.

**Ids and tables.** Replace 4.x ids with the 5.5 ids verbatim (direct `claude-opus-5-5`, `claude-sonnet-5-5`, `claude-haiku-5-5`; Bedrock `us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5`, `us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5`, `us.anthropic.claude-haiku-5-5`). Taken verbatim from `list-inference-profiles` (2026-11-09); Haiku 5.5's has no dated suffix. They go in the three toml files, `config.DEFAULT_MODEL`/`VERIFIER_DEFAULT_MODEL` (`src/rebar/llm/config.py:61,67`), `model_classes.TRIVIAL_DEFAULT_MODEL` (`model_classes.py:45`), `bedrock_model.DEFAULT_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID` and `provider_parity.CLASS_SLOTS`. An explicitly pinned 4.x model keeps working: `MODEL_WINDOW_LADDER` (`model_classes.py:62-66`) becomes the 5.5 escalation ladder (all 1M) and the 4.x windows move to `PRIOR_GENERATION_WINDOWS`, consulted by both `own_window_tokens` and `sizing.largest_window_tokens` before the 200K unlocated floor, so Sonnet 4.6 keeps 1M without cross-generation escalation; `review_kernel/verify.py::MODEL_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS` gains 5.5 rows (128K) beside the 4.x rows. The deploy defaults in `infra/compose/docker-compose.yml:97-99` and the alarm `ModelId` dimensions in `infra/terraform/monitoring_eb6e.tf:80-135` change in the same commit, because `tests/unit/test_reviewbot_bedrock_cutover.py` requires the compose slots to equal `bedrock.toml` byte for byte and the alarms to watch exactly those ids. The post-deploy check that Bedrock publishes metrics under those ids is the sibling task `itchy-neutral-whooper`. `sizing._RUNG_CLASSES` (`plan_review/sizing.py:240`) keys on family substrings; no change.

**Sampling.** Add each 5.5 id (bare, `us.`, `global.`) to `_MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES` (`capabilities.py:223`) with `supports_temperature: False`, the mechanism already used for Opus 4.7/4.8, so `structured_run.build_model_settings` (`:400-404`) omits Pass-2 `temperature=0`.

**Effort, explicit.** rebar sends no `effort` today, so 4.x ran at the documented default `high`; Opus 5.5 defaults to `medium`. `ModelCapabilities` gains `effort`, set by the same exact-id rows as sampling (bare, `us.` and `global.` ids): `high` for Opus and Sonnet 5.5, `medium` for Haiku 5.5 (Haiku 4.5 had none). `structured_run.build_model_settings`, the `model_settings` every call receives (`runner.py:495-518`), sets both provider keys with no provider branch: `anthropic_effort` and `bedrock_additional_model_requests_fields={"output_config": {"effort": ...}}`; each provider model reads only its own. Verified on the wire: `test_the_pinned_effort_reaches_the_wire_on_both_provider_arms` (tests/unit/test_provider_parity.py) captures the outbound direct and Bedrock payloads for each parity slot and asserts `output_config.effort == "high"` on both (passing on pydantic-ai-slim 1.107.9).

**Cache minimum.** Add the three direct 5.5 ids to `_MODEL_CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS` (`capabilities.py:38`) at 512.

**Reasoning-in-output wording (found by the audit).** Bedrock Opus 5.5 declines (`content_filtered`) any request whose output schema asks for reasoning in the response: `analysis` described as "Scratchpad — reason before emitting." (`plan_review/passes.py:72`, `code_review/contracts.py:75,93`) or "REASON FIRST…" (`review_kernel/verify_models.py:126`). Measured: plan-review-T10 and code-review-failover declined 3 of 3; with only that description neutral, both pass. The four descriptions become neutral notes; `tests/unit/test_output_contract_no_reasoning_in_output.py` scans every registered contract.

**Audit.** Walk every model call site (runner, settings builders, provider construction, review kernel, passes, workflow) against the five changes plus the `refusal` stop reason, and record one row per check (site, finding, fix or "not affected") as a ticket comment. Anything needing more than these seams is filed as a bug linked `discovered_from`.

These seams already shape every call, so correcting them corrects every pass without touching the passes. The eval-spec `model:` pins move in the sibling task `real-pubescent-turnstone` (see links).

## Scope

- rebar.toml, .github/llm-providers/bedrock.toml, .github/llm-providers/anthropic.toml
- src/rebar/llm/config.py, model_classes.py, capabilities.py, structured_run.py, agent_call.py, bedrock_model.py
- src/rebar/llm/review_kernel/verify.py
- src/rebar/llm/evals/provider_parity.py, src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/provider_parity_results.json
- infra/compose/docker-compose.yml, infra/terraform/monitoring_eb6e.tf
- tests: the five files a measured spike showed break (all edits applied, 220 test files that name a 4.x id, a changed constant, or a provider/compose/alarm file run: 24 failures in these five, 3,924 passes, including `test_reviewbot_bedrock_cutover.py`): tests/unit/test_model_class_ladder.py, test_model_classes.py, test_plan_review.py, test_provider_parity.py, test_verifier_class.py; plus new cases in tests/unit/test_capabilities.py and tests/unit/test_settings_builders_seam.py.

## Testing

- Happy path: each 5.5 id reports `supports_temperature=False` and a 512 cache minimum; a 5.5 Bedrock request carries `output_config.effort` and no `temperature`; a direct one carries `anthropic_effort`.
- Edge: an unmapped id keeps family defaults; a pinned 4.x id keeps its window; `sizing` maps Haiku 5.5 to `trivial`.
- Live: provider-parity probe and full run once on 4.x before the change and once on 5.5 after, `AWS_PROFILE=frontier-bedrock`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `git grep -nE 'claude-(opus-4-8|sonnet-4-6|haiku-4-5)' -- rebar.toml .github/llm-providers src/rebar/llm/config.py src/rebar/llm/bedrock_model.py src/rebar/llm/evals/provider_parity.py infra/compose/docker-compose.yml infra/terraform/monitoring_eb6e.tf | grep -vE ':[0-9]+:\s*#|``'` prints nothing (no 4.x id remains as a value; comments explaining the dated Haiku 4.5 colon-suffix case keep their real example), and `TRIVIAL_DEFAULT_MODEL` is `"claude-haiku-5-5"`.
- [x] The model-call audit is a ticket comment with one row per call site and API change.
- [x] Every incompatibility the audit finds is fixed here or filed as a linked bug.
- [x] The capability and settings-builder tests under Testing pass.
- [x] A ticket comment records, for each 5.5 model on Bedrock and on direct Anthropic, that a bare call and a call with the pinned `effort` are accepted and a `temperature=0` call is rejected.
- [x] The before and after provider-parity results are recorded in a ticket comment.
- [x] The 5.5 provider-parity run reports `invalid: false` for both slots.
- [x] `tests/unit/test_output_contract_no_reasoning_in_output.py` passes.
- [x] The after prompt-eval run (ticket comment) shows no `content_filter` run error on any plan-review or code-review spec.
- [x] `make verify` exits 0.
